    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">实现一个纯血鸿蒙版（HarmonyOS）的聊天Demo，并可与其它PC、手机端互通！</span>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        鸿蒙原生（HarmonyOS）开发现在的势头非常猛，鸿蒙原生应用也是大势所趋。现在我们来实现一个纯血鸿蒙版的聊天Demo，这个Demo可以与我之前实现的聊天Demo的Windows端、安卓端、iOS端、Linux端互通信息的。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>&nbsp;鸿蒙原生（HarmonyOS）开发现在的势头非常猛，鸿蒙原生应用也是大势所趋。现在我们来实现一个纯血鸿蒙版的聊天Demo，这个Demo可以与我之前实现的聊天Demo的<span class="words-blog hl-git-1" data-tit="Windows" data-pretit="windows">Windows端、安卓端、iOS端、Linux端互通信息的。</span>　　</p>
<h2>一. 开发环境</h2>
<p>开发工具：DevEco Studio 5.1</p>
<p>开发语言：ArkTS</p>
<p>测试手机：华为 Mate 70</p>
<h2>二. Demo 实现的功能</h2>
<p>　　本文ESFramework的鸿蒙版Demo演示了以下功能：</p>
<p>（1）客户端用户上下线时，通知其他在线用户。<br>（2）当客户端与服务端网络断开时，进行自动重连，当网络恢复后，重连成功。<br>（3）所有在线用户之间可以进行文字聊天。<br>（4）文件传送。<br>（5）消息同步调用。<br>（6）重登陆模式。当同名的用户登陆时，会把前面的用户挤掉。</p>
<p>　　这里有该Demo运行的效果&nbsp;<a href="https://www.zhihu.com/zvideo/1964639458814042227" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">演示视频</a>。</p>
<p>　　文末有该Demo鸿蒙端实现的源码，下载源码后，对照着这篇文章看，会更容易理解。　　　</p>
<h2>三. Harmony鸿蒙客户端实现说明</h2>
<p>　　源码解压后，在DevEco Studio中打开Demo项目，其结构如下所示：</p>
<h3>1. 文件目录结构</h3>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202510/20404-20251016172859597-1124606887.png" alt="image" width="350" height="607" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3>2.定义信息类型</h3>
<p><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;在本demo中，我们定义5个信息类型，分别表示文字聊天消息（直接发送给对方），文字聊天消息（由服务端转发），图片消息、撤回消息，以及客户端同步调用服务端。其定义如下:</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">enum</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InformationTypes{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 文字(表情)聊天信息</span>
  TextChat = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 文字(表情)聊天信息 (由服务端转发给消息接收方)</span>
  TextChat4Transit = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 图片聊天信息</span>
  ImageChat = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 收到消息发送者 撤回消息请求</span>
  RecallMsg = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 客户端异步调用服务端</span>
　ClientSyncCallServer = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>3.实现自定义信息处理器</h3>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 客户端的utils里的customizeHandler实现了ICustomizeHandler接口，其主要实现HandleInformation方法，来处理收到的聊天信息。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>handleInformation(sourceUserID: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, informationType: number, info: number[]): <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
   ......
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>4.index.ets 登录页</h3>
<p>　　登录页的样式如图所示:</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202510/20404-20251016173837621-1663424224.png" alt="Screenshot_2025-10-16T173824" width="281" height="607" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　 输入ip、账号、密码后，点击登录，输入的数据会用于初始化RapidPassiveEngine以登录。代码如下:</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">通过@Provide标记engine并定义，可以将engine与后代组件双向同步</span>
@Provide(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">engine</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) engine:RapidPassiveEngine|<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">通过@State将数据设置为响应式的数据</span>
@State ip:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">192.168.0.244</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
@State userId:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">101</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
@State pwd:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">12</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">点击登录按钮</span>
Button(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">登录</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>,{ type: ButtonType.Normal }).onClick(()=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">新建一个ESFramework引擎</span>
     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.engine = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> RapidPassiveEngine()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">通过initialize方法，将登录的ip账号密码传进ESFramework</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.engine.initialize(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.userId, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.pwd ,<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.ip,
                      </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4530</span>,customizeHandlers,(res)=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
                         ......
   })
})</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>5.home.ets 好友/功能页</h3>
<p>　&nbsp; 好友页里实现了好友列表的展示，收到消息后会将消息展示在好友名下方,好友页样式图如下:</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202510/20404-20251017084317065-1129116418.png" alt="Screenshot_2025-10-17T084257" width="281" height="607" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　当用户登录成功后，便可以从服务器获取所有在线联系人，然后客户端只需要处理这些信息即可渲染页面，处理信息代码如下:</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">创建一个User接口</span>
export <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> User{
  username:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  headImg:</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  clientType:ClientType
}
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">在线用户列表</span>
  @State userList:Array&lt;User&gt; =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> []

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">      //</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">登录的时候，直接通过新建的引擎获取服务器里所有的在线成员,res为所有在线成员数组</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.engine.ContactsOutter.getAllOnlineContacts((res:Array&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;)=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">在这里添加用户列表</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">         ......
      })
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">       //</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">监听联系人上线事件</span>
       <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.engine.ContactsOutter.<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">event</span>[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ContactsDeviceConnected</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] =()=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
       </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">如果有联系人上线，将会进入这个函数</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">       ......
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　用户列表渲染主要代码如下:</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      Column() {
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">使用List来渲染用户列表</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        List() {
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">通过foreach获取到每一个用户的信息</span>
          ForEach(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.userList, (item:User) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            ListItem() {
              Flex({direction:FlexDirection.Row,alignItems:ItemAlign.Center}){
                Image(item.headImg)<br>                Flex({direction:FlexDirection.Column,justifyContent:FlexAlign.SpaceBetween}){
                  Text(`${item.username}`)</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                }
              }
            }
          })
        }
      }</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>6. chat.ets 聊天页</h3>
<p>　　当有联系人向我发送消息，消息各项信息会进入已经实现的customizeHandler里的handleInformation里，客户端处理这些信息即可渲染画面，聊天页的样式如图所示:</p>
<p>　　<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/20404/202510/20404-20251013094527183-694315812.png" alt="Screenshot_2025-10-13T094515" width="281" height="607" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;　处理相关代码如下:</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">在utils.ets文件里的customizeHandler类里,需要设置信息处理回调函数,外部才能通过传一个callback获取到收到消息的信息</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> handleInformationCallback ?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: Function;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">设置信息处理回调函数</span>
  setHandleInformationCallback(callback : Function) : <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.handleInformationCallback =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> callback;
  }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">处理来自其他用户的信息(包括大数据块信息)</span>
   handleInformation(sourceUserID: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, informationType: number, info: number[]): <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.handleInformationCallback) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">将收到的信息传递到信息处理回调函数里</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.handleInformationCallback(sourceUserID, informationType,util.getStr(info))
    }
  }

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">在index.ets里
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">设置聊天记录字典，键为用户id,值为聊天记录数组对象,message为聊天记录数据接口。</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">OrayDic为ESFramework内置的设置字典的方法
@Provide(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">userMessages</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) userMessages: OrayDic&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, Array&lt;Message&gt;&gt; = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OrayDic();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">获取自定义消息处理器</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> customizeHandlers = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> customizeHandler()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">设置消息的监听</span>
customizeHandlers.setHandleInformationCallback((sendID:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>,informationType:number,chatInfo:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>)=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">收到的文字图片信息都会进入这里，在这里处理聊天记录</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  ......
})</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　 聊天记录主要渲染代码如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Column(){
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">通过List渲染聊天记录</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">          List(){
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">通过ForEach来获取每一个聊天信息</span>
            ForEach(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.currentUserMessages,(item:Message)=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
              ListItem(){
                Column(){
                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">文字信息</span>
                  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(item.informationType == InformationTypes.TextChat || item.informationType ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InformationTypes.TextChat4Transit){
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">对方普通文字消息</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(item.SpeakerID == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.user?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.username){
                      ......
                    }
                     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">我方普通文字信息</span>
                      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
                     ......
                  }
                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">图片信息</span>
                  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(item.informationType ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InformationTypes.ImageChat) {
                      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">对方图片信息</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(item.SpeakerID == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.user?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.username) {
                      ......
                    }
                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">我方图片消息</span>
                  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
                      ......
                  }
                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">文件信息</span>
                  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(item.informationType ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InformationTypes.File){
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">对方文件消息</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(item.SpeakerID == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.user?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.username){
                      ......
                    }
                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">我方文件信息</span>
                  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
                      ......
                  }
                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">撤回信息
                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> if(item.informationType === InformationTypes.RecallMsg)</span>
                  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(item.informationType ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InformationTypes.RecallMsg) {
                    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">对方撤回消息</span>
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(item.SpeakerID == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.user?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.username){
                      ......
                    }
                  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">我方撤回信息</span>
                  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
                      ......

                }
              }
            })
          }
        }</span></pre>

<p>&nbsp;　　Demo鸿蒙客户端的主要功能代码就是上面这些，代码有较详细的注释，所以，这里就不进一步说明了。　</p>
<h2>四.服务端说明</h2>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;为了方便测试，文末下载的源码压缩包中，还提供了可以直接运行的该Demo的 Windows 服务端和 Windows 客户端程序，服务端运行起来后，界面如下所示：&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/9005/202510/9005-20251023144421688-34482900.png" alt="ESF_Harmony06" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　&nbsp; &nbsp;该Demo 不仅鸿蒙客户端之间可以相互通信，鸿蒙客户端和其他端（如Windows客户端）之间也可以相互通信的。</p>
<h2>五.源码下载</h2>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Demo 源码：<a title="ESFramework-Harmony-Demo.rar" href="https://dl.oraycn.com/DownLoadFiles/OMCS/ESFramework-Harmony-Demo.rar" rel="noopener nofollow">Harmony-Demo.rar</a>&nbsp;</p>
<p>　&nbsp; 如果还需要其他系统的服务端和客户端（如Windows、Linux、安卓、iOS等）程序的源码，可以到&nbsp;<a title="这里下载" href="https://blog.oraycn.com/ESFramework_Demo_Simplest2022.aspx" rel="noopener nofollow">这里下载</a>。</p>
